name: Gorillas Direct
approach: From the Esmeralda/Lake Ingalls Trailhead at the end of FS-9737, hike the Ingalls Way Trail up switchbacks past several waterfalls. For the Cascadian Couloir and South Headwall, turn right onto the Longs Pass Trail at the junction about 1.7 miles in, climb to Longs Pass (about 6,250 ft) near mile 2.9, and descend the rocky climbers' trail on the far side to Ingalls Creek, cross on a log bridge, and follow the climbers' path up the meadow into the base of the Cascadian Couloir (South Headwall lies further up-basin via the same drainage). For West Ridge, the North Ridge routes, and the South Face (Gorillas in the Mist / Gorillas Direct / King Kong), instead stay on the Ingalls Way Trail over Ingalls Pass (about 6,500 ft, roughly mile 3) and continue past Ingalls Lake toward Stuart Pass, then follow the climbers' trail onto the talus shoulder below Stuart's West Ridge and contour northwest to Goat Pass (7,600 ft) — the South Face wall with the Gorillas routes sits in the amphitheater roughly midway between Stuart Pass and Goat Pass, while West Ridge and North Ridge climbers continue over or along Goat Pass toward their respective start points. Camping is common near Goat Pass or down at Ingalls Creek depending on the objective. The North Ridge routes can also be reached from the opposite (Mountaineer Creek) side.

waypoints.name: Esmeralda Basin Trailhead (North Fork Teanaway Rd)
waypoints.note: Ingalls Way trail via Esmeralda Basin; shared approach for the Gorillas routes on Stuart's south/west side.
waypoints.directions: Drive the North Fork Teanaway Road (FR-9737) to its end, where the Esmeralda Basin Trailhead — also known as the Lake Ingalls trailhead — sits at about 4,270 ft. The Ingalls Way Trail starts here and climbs toward Ingalls Pass and Ingalls Lake. This is the Teanaway side of Stuart, so make sure it is the lot you want: the North Ridge routes on this mountain are also reached from the opposite Mountaineer Creek side.

waypoints.name: Ingalls Pass
waypoints.note: Trail crest crossing en route toward Stuart Pass/Goat Pass and the West Face Wall between them.
waypoints.directions: Follow the Esmeralda Basin Trail a short way and turn right onto Ingalls Way #1390. It switchbacks up past several waterfalls; stay on it where the Longs Pass trail branches right, and continue to Ingalls Pass at about 6,500 ft.

waypoints.name: Mount Stuart summit area
waypoints.note: Route climbs the ~1000' West Face Wall between Stuart Pass and Goat Pass, topping out on the upper West Ridge near the true summit.
waypoints.directions: Follow the trail through Headlight Basin and past Ingalls Lake toward Stuart Pass, then take the climbers' trail onto the talus shoulder below the West Ridge and contour to the amphitheater midway between Stuart Pass and Goat Pass. The route starts at a splitter crack on a ledge 15-25 ft above the snow and climbs the roughly 1,000 ft West Face Wall to the upper West Ridge; follow the ridge to the summit.
